@echo off
setlocal enabledelayedexpansion
cd /d "%~dp0"

where dotnet >nul 2>nul
if errorlevel 1 (
  echo .NET SDK not found. Install .NET 11 or .NET 10 SDK from https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download
  pause
  exit /b 1
)

set "SDK_MAJOR="
for /f "tokens=1 delims=." %%a in ('dotnet --version') do set "SDK_MAJOR=%%a"
if "%SDK_MAJOR%"=="" set "SDK_MAJOR=8"
set "TFM=net%SDK_MAJOR%.0"

echo Detected .NET SDK major version %SDK_MAJOR% - using %TFM%
echo Restoring packages from nuget.org...
dotnet restore ModpackWorkbench\ModpackWorkbench.csproj -p:TargetFramework=%TFM% --source https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json
if errorlevel 1 (
  echo.
  echo Package restore failed. Check internet connection / proxy access to https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json
  pause
  exit /b 1
)

echo Starting ModpackWorkbench (Avalonia UI)...
dotnet run --project ModpackWorkbench -p:TargetFramework=%TFM% --no-restore
if errorlevel 1 (
  echo.
  echo Launch failed. Check errors above.
  pause
)

files.content:
# Верстак сборок (C# + .NET 8 + Avalonia UI 11)

Нативный кроссплатформенный десктопный порт приложения «Верстак сборок» на **C# (.NET 8)** и **Avalonia UI 11 (MVVM)**.

## Архитектура проекта

- `ModpackWorkbench.sln` — решение Visual Studio / Rider / .NET CLI
- `ModpackWorkbench/` — основное настольное приложение Avalonia UI 11 (`CommunityToolkit.Mvvm`)
  - `Models/` — модели данных модов, слотов (`ModGroupInfo`), правил конфликтов (`IncompatibilityRule`), пресетов, диагностики, конфигурации темы (`BuilderThemeConfig`) и состояния (`PersistedAppState`)
  - `Services/`
    - `ModDatabase.cs` — загрузка встроенных JSON-баз (`Assets/Data/db/*.json`)
    - `ModAnalyzer.cs` — анализ конфликтов, зависимостей, дубликатов, мостов EMI/JEI/TMRV, тиров стабильности (`Green`/`Lime`/`Yellow`/`Orange`/`Red`) и поиск на русском языке с учётом синонимов и стемминга
    - `ModBuilder.cs` — умный конструктор сборки (`BuildSmartAssembly`), авто-исправление (`SmartFixAssembly`), переключение модов с каскадом зависимостей (`ToggleModSmart`)
    - `ModTreeService.cs` — иерархия «Мод → Аддоны», экспорт дерева и импорт списков модов
    - `JarMatcherService.cs` — сопоставление имён `.jar` файлов и нативное сканирование папки `mods/` (с проверкой `.connector` и алиаса `embeddium -> sodium`)
    - `PersistenceService.cs` — сохранение состояния в `%AppData%/ModpackWorkbench/workbench-state.json`
    - `ThemeService.cs` — управление светлой/тёмной темой, пресетами оформления и динамическими ресурсами
  - `Controls/FractalBackdropControl.cs` — рендеринг углового свечения и математических фракталов (Жюлиа, Мандельброт, Лоренц, Папоротник, Дракон, Кох, Серпинский, Дерево)
  - `ViewModels/` & `Views/` — экраны:
    - **Каталог** (`CatalogView`)
    - **Клипание / Конструктор** (`AssemblyBuilderView`)
    - **Сборки и Золотой стандарт** (`PresetsView`)
    - **Чекер и сканер `mods/`** (`CheckerView`)
    - **Карточка мода** (`ModDetailWindow`)
    - **Настройки темы** (`ThemeConfiguratorView`)
- `ModpackWorkbench.Tests/` — модульные и headless-UI тесты на xUnit + `Avalonia.Headless.XUnit`

## Запуск и тесты

```bash
dotnet restore ModpackWorkbench.sln
dotnet build ModpackWorkbench.sln
dotnet test ModpackWorkbench.sln
dotnet run --project ModpackWorkbench/ModpackWorkbench.csproj
```

<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:vm="using:ModpackWorkbench.ViewModels"
             xmlns:conv="using:ModpackWorkbench.Converters"
             x:Class="ModpackWorkbench.Views.AssemblyBuilderView">

  <StackPanel Spacing="14">
    <!-- Header Bar -->
    <Border Classes="ui-block" Padding="14">
      <StackPanel Spacing="10">
        <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
          <StackPanel Grid.Column="0" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="10" VerticalAlignment="Center">
            <TextBlock Text="Клипание сборок" FontSize="16" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
            <TextBlock FontSize="12" FontFamily="Consolas, monospace" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" VerticalAlignment="Center">
              <Run Text="{Binding SelectedCount}" />
              <Run Text=" модов" />
            </TextBlock>
          </StackPanel>

          <WrapPanel Grid.Column="1" Orientation="Horizontal">
            <WrapPanel.Styles>
              <Style Selector="WrapPanel > :is(Control)">
                <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,6,6" />
              </Style>
            </WrapPanel.Styles>
            <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Presets}">
              <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                <ItemsPanelTemplate>
                  <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6" />
                </ItemsPanelTemplate>
              </ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
              <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                <DataTemplate>
                  <Button Classes="ui-btn"
                          Command="{Binding $parent[UserControl].DataContext.LoadPresetCommand}"
                          CommandParameter="{Binding}"
                          Content="{Binding Name}" />
                </DataTemplate>
              </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
            </ItemsControl>

            <Button Classes="ui-btn-accent"
                    IsVisible="{Binding IssueCount}"
                    Command="{Binding FixIssuesCommand}">
              <TextBlock>
                <Run Text="Исправить (" /><Run Text="{Binding IssueCount}" /><Run Text=")" />
              </TextBlock>
            </Button>

            <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding ResetAssemblyCommand}" Content="Сброс" />
          </WrapPanel>
        </Grid>

        <!-- Smart Configurator -->
        <Border Background="{DynamicResource SurfaceSubBrush}" CornerRadius="6" Padding="10">
          <StackPanel Spacing="8">
            <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
              <Button Grid.Column="0" Command="{Binding ToggleSmartConfigCommand}"
                      Background="Transparent" BorderThickness="0" Padding="0" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Cursor="Hand">
                <TextBlock Text="Умный авто-конструктор сборки (GPU / Режим / Шейдеры / Create / Порты)"
                           FontSize="12.5" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentTextBrush}" />
              </Button>
              <Button Grid.Column="1" Classes="ui-btn-accent"
                      Command="{Binding BuildSmartCommand}" Content="Пересобрать умно" />
            </Grid>

            <StackPanel IsVisible="{Binding SmartConfigOpen}" Spacing="8">
              <WrapPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                <WrapPanel.Styles>
                  <Style Selector="WrapPanel > :is(Control)">
                    <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,12,6" />
                  </Style>
                </WrapPanel.Styles>
                <StackPanel Spacing="3">
                  <TextBlock Text="Видеокарта" FontSize="11" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" />
                  <ComboBox ItemsSource="{Binding GpuOptions}"
                            SelectedValue="{Binding Gpu}"
                            SelectedValueBinding="{Binding Key}"
                            DisplayMemberBinding="{Binding Label}" Width="190" />
                </StackPanel>
                <StackPanel Spacing="3">
                  <TextBlock Text="Режим игры" FontSize="11" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" />
                  <ComboBox ItemsSource="{Binding ModeOptions}"
                            SelectedValue="{Binding Mode}"
                            SelectedValueBinding="{Binding Key}"
                            DisplayMemberBinding="{Binding Label}" Width="210" />
                </StackPanel>
                <StackPanel Spacing="3">
                  <TextBlock Text="Цель" FontSize="11" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" />
                  <ComboBox ItemsSource="{Binding GoalOptions}"
                            SelectedValue="{Binding Goal}"
                            SelectedValueBinding="{Binding Key}"
                            DisplayMemberBinding="{Binding Label}" Width="175" />
                </StackPanel>
                <StackPanel Spacing="3">
                  <TextBlock Text="Стратегия портов" FontSize="11" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" />
                  <ComboBox ItemsSource="{Binding PortStrategyOptions}"
                            SelectedValue="{Binding PortStrategy}"
                            SelectedValueBinding="{Binding Key}"
                            DisplayMemberBinding="{Binding Label}" Width="190" />
                </StackPanel>
                <StackPanel Spacing="3">
                  <TextBlock Text="Рецепты (JEI/EMI)" FontSize="11" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" />
                  <ComboBox ItemsSource="{Binding RecipeViewerOptions}"
                            SelectedValue="{Binding RecipeViewer}"
                            SelectedValueBinding="{Binding Key}"
                            DisplayMemberBinding="{Binding Label}" Width="170" />
                </StackPanel>
              </WrapPanel>

              <WrapPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                <WrapPanel.Styles>
                  <Style Selector="WrapPanel > :is(Control)">
                    <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,16,4" />
                  </Style>
                </WrapPanel.Styles>
                <CheckBox IsChecked="{Binding UseShaders}" Content="Играю с шейдерами" FontSize="12" />
                <CheckBox IsChecked="{Binding UseCreate}" Content="Create / тяжёлая индустрия" FontSize="12" />
                <CheckBox IsChecked="{Binding AllowSinytra}" Content="Разрешить Sinytra Connector (Fabric)" FontSize="12" />
              </WrapPanel>

              <!-- Smart Notes -->
              <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding SmartNotes}" IsVisible="{Binding SmartNotes.Count}">
                <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                  <DataTemplate>
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding}" FontSize="11.5" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}"
                               TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,1" />
                  </DataTemplate>
                </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
              </ItemsControl>
            </StackPanel>
          </StackPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- Search & Slot Controls -->
        <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
          <TextBox Grid.Column="0" Classes="ui-input"
                   Text="{Binding SlotSearch, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                   Watermark="Фильтр слотов и модов по названию или назначению..." />
          <Button Grid.Column="1" Margin="8,0,0,0" Classes="ui-btn"
                  Command="{Binding ToggleStrictExclusiveCommand}"
                  Content="{Binding StrictExclusive, Converter={x:Static conv:BoolToActiveStringConverter.Instance}, ConverterParameter='🔒 1 мод на слот|🔓 Свободный выбор'}" />
        </Grid>

        <!-- Notice Banner -->
        <Border IsVisible="{Binding ActionNotice, Converter={x:Static StringConverters.IsNotNullOrEmpty}}"
                Background="#262563EB" BorderBrush="#6660A5FA" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="6" Padding="10,6">
          <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
            <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" Text="{Binding ActionNotice}" FontSize="12" Foreground="#BFDBFE" VerticalAlignment="Center" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
            <Button Grid.Column="1" Classes="ui-btn" Padding="6,2" Command="{Binding DismissNoticeCommand}" Content="✕" />
          </Grid>
        </Border>
      </StackPanel>
    </Border>

    <!-- Multiplayer Quick-Add Block -->
    <Border Classes="ui-block" Padding="0">
      <StackPanel>
        <Border Background="{DynamicResource SurfaceSubBrush}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderSoftBrush}"
                BorderThickness="0,0,0,1" Padding="14,8">
          <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
            <Button Grid.Column="0" Command="{Binding ToggleMultiplayerSectionCommand}"
                    Background="Transparent" BorderThickness="0" Padding="0" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Cursor="Hand">
              <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="8">
                <TextBlock Text="Для мультиплеера и серверов" FontSize="13.5" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                           Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
                <TextBlock FontSize="11.5" FontFamily="Consolas, monospace" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                  <Run Text="(" /><Run Text="{Binding ActiveMultiplayerCount}" /><Run Text="/4)" />
                </TextBlock>
              </StackPanel>
            </Button>
            <Button Grid.Column="1" Classes="ui-btn-accent"
                    Command="{Binding ToggleMultiplayerPackCommand}"
                    Content="Добавить / Убрать пакет (4)" />
          </Grid>
        </Border>

        <ItemsControl IsVisible="{Binding MultiplayerOpen}" ItemsSource="{Binding MultiplayerMods}">
          <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
            <DataTemplate x:DataType="vm:BuilderModRowViewModel">
              <Border BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderSoftBrush}" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1" Padding="14,7">
                <Grid ColumnDefinitions="4,Auto,*,Auto">
                  <Border Grid.Column="0" CornerRadius="2"
                          Background="{Binding TierColorHex, Converter={x:Static conv:HexToBrushConverter.Instance}}" />
                  <CheckBox Grid.Column="1" Margin="8,0" IsChecked="{Binding IsSelected, Mode=OneWay}"
                            Command="{Binding ToggleCommand}" />
                  <StackPanel Grid.Column="2" Spacing="1">
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
                      <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontSize="13" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
                      <TextBlock IsVisible="{Binding ShowSinytraTag}" Text="Sinytra" FontSize="10"
                                 FontFamily="Consolas, monospace" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                    </StackPanel>
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding ReasonText}" FontSize="11" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}"
                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                  </StackPanel>
                  <StackPanel Grid.Column="3" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
                    <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding OpenDetailsCommand}" Content="Инфо" />
                    <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding OpenCurseForgeCommand}" Content="CF" />
                  </StackPanel>
                </Grid>
              </Border>
            </DataTemplate>
          </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
        </ItemsControl>
      </StackPanel>
    </Border>

    <!-- Optimization & EMI Slots -->
    <TextBlock Text="ОПТИМИЗАЦИЯ И EMI" FontSize="11" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" Margin="2,4,0,0" />
    <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding OptimizationBuckets}">
      <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
        <DataTemplate x:DataType="vm:BuilderBucketViewModel">
          <Border Classes="ui-block" Margin="0,0,0,8">
            <StackPanel>
              <Border Background="{DynamicResource SurfaceSubBrush}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderSoftBrush}"
                      BorderThickness="0,0,0,1" Padding="14,8">
                <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
                  <StackPanel Grid.Column="0" Spacing="2">
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="8">
                      <TextBlock Text="{Binding Title}" FontSize="13.5" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
                      <TextBlock IsVisible="{Binding HasSelected}" FontSize="11" FontFamily="Consolas, monospace"
                                 Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentTextBrush}" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                        <Run Text="(" /><Run Text="{Binding SelectedCount}" /><Run Text=")" />
                      </TextBlock>
                    </StackPanel>
                    <TextBlock IsVisible="{Binding ShowDescriptions}" Text="{Binding Description}" FontSize="11"
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
                  </StackPanel>

                  <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <Button Classes="ui-btn" IsVisible="{Binding ShowSelectLeaderButton}"
                            Command="{Binding SelectLeaderCommand}" Content="+ Лидер" />
                    <Button Classes="ui-btn" IsVisible="{Binding HasSelected}"
                            Command="{Binding ClearSlotCommand}" Content="Очистить" />
                    <Button Classes="ui-btn" IsVisible="{Binding HasAddons}"
                            Command="{Binding ToggleAddonsCommand}" Content="{Binding AddonsToggleLabel}" />
                    <Button Classes="ui-btn" IsVisible="{Binding HasHidden}"
                            Command="{Binding ToggleHiddenCommand}" Content="{Binding HiddenToggleLabel}" />
                  </StackPanel>
                </Grid>
              </Border>

              <!-- Core Mods -->
              <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding PrimaryCoreMods}">
                <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                  <DataTemplate x:DataType="vm:BuilderModRowViewModel">
                    <Border BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderSoftBrush}" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1" Padding="14,7">
                      <Grid ColumnDefinitions="4,Auto,*,Auto">
                        <Border Grid.Column="0" CornerRadius="2"
                                Background="{Binding TierColorHex, Converter={x:Static conv:HexToBrushConverter.Instance}}" />
                        <CheckBox Grid.Column="1" Margin="8,0" IsChecked="{Binding IsSelected, Mode=OneWay}"
                                  Command="{Binding ToggleCommand}" />
                        <StackPanel Grid.Column="2" Spacing="1">
                          <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontSize="13" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
                            <TextBlock IsVisible="{Binding IsCoreExclusive}" Text="· 1 в слоте" FontSize="10" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                            <TextBlock IsVisible="{Binding ShowSinytraTag}" Text="Sinytra" FontSize="10" FontFamily="Consolas, monospace" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                          </StackPanel>
                          <TextBlock Text="{Binding ReasonText}" FontSize="11" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                        </StackPanel>
                        <StackPanel Grid.Column="3" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
                          <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding OpenDetailsCommand}" Content="Инфо" />
                          <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding OpenCurseForgeCommand}" Content="CF" />
                        </StackPanel>

              <!-- Addon Mods -->
              <ItemsControl IsVisible="{Binding IsAddonsExpanded}" ItemsSource="{Binding AddonMods}">
                <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                  <DataTemplate x:DataType="vm:BuilderModRowViewModel">
                    <Border Background="{DynamicResource SurfaceSubBrush}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderSoftBrush}"
                            BorderThickness="0,0,0,1" Padding="32,6,14,6">
                      <Grid ColumnDefinitions="4,Auto,*,Auto">
                        <Border Grid.Column="0" CornerRadius="2"
                                Background="{Binding TierColorHex, Converter={x:Static conv:HexToBrushConverter.Instance}}" />
                        <CheckBox Grid.Column="1" Margin="8,0" IsChecked="{Binding IsSelected, Mode=OneWay}"

                        <StackPanel Grid.Column="2" Spacing="1">
                          <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontSize="12.5" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
                          <TextBlock Text="{Binding ReasonText}" FontSize="11" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                        </StackPanel>
                        <StackPanel Grid.Column="3" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
                          <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding OpenDetailsCommand}" Content="Инфо" />
                          <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding OpenCurseForgeCommand}" Content="CF" />
                        </StackPanel>
                      </Grid>
                    </Border>
                  </DataTemplate>
                </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
              </ItemsControl>

              <!-- Hidden / Incompatible Mods -->
              <ItemsControl IsVisible="{Binding IsHiddenExpanded}" ItemsSource="{Binding HiddenMods}">
                <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                  <DataTemplate x:DataType="vm:BuilderModRowViewModel">
                    <Border Background="#14F59E0B" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderSoftBrush}"
                            BorderThickness="0,0,0,1" Padding="32,6,14,6">
                      <Grid ColumnDefinitions="4,Auto,*,Auto">
                        <Border Grid.Column="0" CornerRadius="2"
                                Background="{Binding TierColorHex, Converter={x:Static conv:HexToBrushConverter.Instance}}" />
                        <CheckBox Grid.Column="1" Margin="8,0" IsChecked="{Binding IsSelected, Mode=OneWay}"
                                  Command="{Binding ToggleCommand}" />
                        <StackPanel Grid.Column="2" Spacing="1">
                          <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontSize="12.5" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
                          <TextBlock Text="{Binding ReasonText}" FontSize="11" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                        </StackPanel>
                        <StackPanel Grid.Column="3" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
                          <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding OpenDetailsCommand}" Content="Инфо" />
                          <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding OpenCurseForgeCommand}" Content="CF" />
                        </StackPanel>
                      </Grid>
                    </Border>
                  </DataTemplate>
                </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
              </ItemsControl>
            </StackPanel>
          </Border>
        </DataTemplate>
      </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
    </ItemsControl>

    <!-- Other / Niche Slots -->
    <TextBlock Text="ДРУГОЕ · ЧАСТНЫЕ МОДЫ (GECKOLIB, CREATE, ФИКСЫ И ДИАГНОСТИКА)"
               FontSize="11" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" Margin="2,4,0,0" />
    <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding OtherBuckets}">
      <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
        <DataTemplate x:DataType="vm:BuilderBucketViewModel">
          <Border Classes="ui-block" Margin="0,0,0,8">
            <StackPanel>
              <Border Background="{DynamicResource SurfaceSubBrush}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderSoftBrush}"
                      BorderThickness="0,0,0,1" Padding="14,8">
                <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
                  <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" Text="{Binding Title}" FontSize="13.5" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                             Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                  <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
                    <Button Classes="ui-btn" IsVisible="{Binding ShowSelectLeaderButton}"
                            Command="{Binding SelectLeaderCommand}" Content="+ Лидер" />
                    <Button Classes="ui-btn" IsVisible="{Binding HasSelected}"
                            Command="{Binding ClearSlotCommand}" Content="Очистить" />
                    <Button Classes="ui-btn" IsVisible="{Binding HasHidden}"
                            Command="{Binding ToggleHiddenCommand}" Content="{Binding HiddenToggleLabel}" />
                  </StackPanel>
                </Grid>
              </Border>
              <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding PrimaryCoreMods}">
                <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                  <DataTemplate x:DataType="vm:BuilderModRowViewModel">
                    <Border BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderSoftBrush}" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1" Padding="14,7">
                      <Grid ColumnDefinitions="4,Auto,*,Auto">
                        <Border Grid.Column="0" CornerRadius="2"
                                Background="{Binding TierColorHex, Converter={x:Static conv:HexToBrushConverter.Instance}}" />
                        <CheckBox Grid.Column="1" Margin="8,0" IsChecked="{Binding IsSelected, Mode=OneWay}"
                                  Command="{Binding ToggleCommand}" />
                        <StackPanel Grid.Column="2" Spacing="1">
                          <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontSize="13" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
                          <TextBlock Text="{Binding ReasonText}" FontSize="11" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                        </StackPanel>
                        <StackPanel Grid.Column="3" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">

                  </DataTemplate>
                </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
              </ItemsControl>
            </StackPanel>
          </Border>
        </DataTemplate>
      </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
    </ItemsControl>
  </StackPanel>
</UserControl>

<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:vm="using:ModpackWorkbench.ViewModels"
             xmlns:conv="using:ModpackWorkbench.Converters"
             x:Class="ModpackWorkbench.Views.CatalogView">

  <StackPanel Spacing="12">
    <!-- Filter Header -->
    <Border Classes="ui-block" Padding="14">
      <StackPanel Spacing="10">
        <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto,Auto,Auto">
          <TextBox Grid.Column="0" Classes="ui-input"
                   Text="{Binding SearchQuery, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                   Watermark="Поиск по названию или назначению (например: фпс, утечки, тени, create, чанки)..." />
          <Button Grid.Column="1" Classes="ui-btn" Margin="8,0,0,0"
                  Command="{Binding ClearSearchCommand}" Content="Сброс" />
          <ComboBox Grid.Column="2" Margin="8,0,0,0" Width="180"
                    ItemsSource="{Binding Categories}"
                    SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedCategory}" />
          <TextBlock Grid.Column="3" Margin="12,0,0,0" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                     FontSize="12" FontFamily="Consolas, monospace"
                     Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}">
            <Run Text="Найдено: " />
            <Run Text="{Binding TotalFilteredCount}" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
          </TextBlock>
        </Grid>

        <WrapPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
          <WrapPanel.Styles>
            <Style Selector="WrapPanel > :is(Control)">
              <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,10,4" />
            </Style>
          </WrapPanel.Styles>
          <CheckBox IsChecked="{Binding OnlyLeaders}" Content="Только лидеры слотов" FontSize="12" />
          <CheckBox IsChecked="{Binding HideUselessCovered}" Content="Скрыть устаревшие / плацебо" FontSize="12" />
          <CheckBox IsChecked="{Binding OnlyCompatibleInCatalog}" Content="Только совместимые со сборкой" FontSize="12" />

          <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6" Margin="12,0,0,0">
            <TextBlock Text="Статус:" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="12" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" />
            <ComboBox ItemsSource="{Binding HealthOptions}"
                      SelectedValue="{Binding HealthFilter}"
                      SelectedValueBinding="{Binding Key}"
                      DisplayMemberBinding="{Binding Label}" Width="165" />
          </StackPanel>

          <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
            <TextBlock Text="Сортировка:" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="12" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" />
            <ComboBox ItemsSource="{Binding SortOptions}"
                      SelectedValue="{Binding SortBy}"
                      SelectedValueBinding="{Binding Key}"
                      DisplayMemberBinding="{Binding Label}" Width="150" />
          </StackPanel>
        </WrapPanel>
      </StackPanel>
    </Border>

    <!-- Mod Rows -->
    <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Rows}">
      <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
        <DataTemplate x:DataType="vm:CatalogRowViewModel">
          <Border Classes="ui-block" Margin="0,0,0,6" Padding="12,9">
            <StackPanel Spacing="6">
              <Grid ColumnDefinitions="4,*,Auto">
                <!-- Status Accent Strip -->
                <Border Grid.Column="0" CornerRadius="2"
                        Background="{Binding TierColorHex, Converter={x:Static conv:HexToBrushConverter.Instance}}" />

                <!-- Info -->
                <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Margin="10,0,12,0" Spacing="2">
                  <WrapPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                    <Button Command="{Binding OpenDetailsCommand}"
                            Background="Transparent" BorderThickness="0" Padding="0" Cursor="Hand">
                      <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontSize="13.5" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                 Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
                    </Button>
                    <Border IsVisible="{Binding IsGroupLeader}" Margin="8,0,0,0" Padding="6,1"
                            CornerRadius="4" Background="#2010B981" BorderBrush="#6610B981" BorderThickness="1">
                      <TextBlock Text="Лидер" FontSize="10" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="#A7F3D0" />
                    </Border>
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding GroupTitle}" Margin="8,2,0,0" FontSize="11"
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" />
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Platform}" Margin="8,2,0,0" FontSize="11"
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" />
                    <TextBlock IsVisible="{Binding UpdatedLabel, Converter={x:Static StringConverters.IsNotNullOrEmpty}}"
                               Text="{Binding UpdatedLabel}" Margin="8,2,0,0" FontSize="11"
                               FontFamily="Consolas, monospace" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" />
                  </WrapPanel>

                  <TextBlock Text="{Binding Description}" TextWrapping="Wrap" MaxLines="2"
                             FontSize="12" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" />

                  <TextBlock IsVisible="{Binding RestrictionText, Converter={x:Static StringConverters.IsNotNullOrEmpty}}"
                             Text="{Binding RestrictionText}" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                             Foreground="{Binding TierColorHex, Converter={x:Static conv:HexToBrushConverter.Instance}}" />
                </StackPanel>

                <!-- Actions -->
                <StackPanel Grid.Column="2" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                  <Button Classes="ui-btn" IsVisible="{Binding HasAddons}"
                          Command="{Binding ToggleAddonsCommand}"
                          Content="{Binding AddonsButtonText}" />
                  <Button Classes="ui-btn" IsVisible="{Binding HasAnalogs}"
                          Command="{Binding ToggleAnalogsCommand}"
                          Content="{Binding AnalogsButtonText}" />
                  <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding OpenDetailsCommand}" Content="Подробнее" />
                  <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding OpenCurseForgeCommand}" Content="CF" />
                  <Button Command="{Binding ToggleInAssemblyCommand}"
                          Classes="ui-btn-accent"
                          Content="{Binding IsSelectedInAssembly, Converter={x:Static conv:BoolToActiveStringConverter.Instance}, ConverterParameter='В сборке ✓|+ В сборку'}" />
                </StackPanel>
              </Grid>

              <!-- Expanded Addons -->
              <Border IsVisible="{Binding IsAddonsExpanded}"
                      Background="{DynamicResource SurfaceSubBrush}"
                      CornerRadius="6" Padding="10,6" Margin="14,4,0,0">
                <StackPanel Spacing="4">
                  <TextBlock Text="Совместимые аддоны слота:" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                             Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentTextBrush}" />
                  <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Addons}">
                    <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                      <DataTemplate>
                        <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto" Margin="0,2">
                          <StackPanel Grid.Column="0">
                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontSize="12" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Description}" FontSize="11"
                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                          </StackPanel>
                          <Button Grid.Column="1" Classes="ui-btn" Content="Переключить"
                                  Command="{Binding $parent[ItemsControl;1].DataContext.ToggleSubModCommand}"
                                  CommandParameter="{Binding}" />
                        </Grid>
                      </DataTemplate>
                    </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                  </ItemsControl>
                </StackPanel>
              </Border>

              <!-- Expanded Analogs -->
              <Border IsVisible="{Binding IsAnalogsExpanded}"
                      Background="{DynamicResource SurfaceSubBrush}"
                      CornerRadius="6" Padding="10,6" Margin="14,4,0,0">
                <StackPanel Spacing="4">
                  <TextBlock Text="Альтернативы / аналоги в этом слоте:" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                             Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" />
                  <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Analogs}">
                    <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                      <DataTemplate>
                        <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto" Margin="0,2">
                          <StackPanel Grid.Column="0">
                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontSize="12" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding StatusLabel}" FontSize="11"
                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" />
                          </StackPanel>
                          <Button Grid.Column="1" Classes="ui-btn" Content="Переключить"
                                  Command="{Binding $parent[ItemsControl;1].DataContext.ToggleSubModCommand}"
                                  CommandParameter="{Binding}" />
                        </Grid>
                      </DataTemplate>
                    </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                  </ItemsControl>
                </StackPanel>
              </Border>
            </StackPanel>
          </Border>
        </DataTemplate>
      </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
    </ItemsControl>
  </StackPanel>
</UserControl>

<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:vm="using:ModpackWorkbench.ViewModels"
             xmlns:conv="using:ModpackWorkbench.Converters"
             x:Class="ModpackWorkbench.Views.CheckerView">

  <StackPanel Spacing="14">
    <!-- Top Toolbar Card -->
    <Border Classes="ui-block" Padding="14">
      <StackPanel Spacing="10">
        <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
          <StackPanel Grid.Column="0" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="10" VerticalAlignment="Center">
            <TextBlock Text="Чекер сборки" FontSize="16" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
            <TextBlock FontSize="12" FontFamily="Consolas, monospace" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" VerticalAlignment="Center">
              <Run Text="{Binding TotalCount}" />
              <Run Text=" модов" />
            </TextBlock>
          </StackPanel>

          <WrapPanel Grid.Column="1" Orientation="Horizontal">
            <WrapPanel.Styles>
              <Style Selector="WrapPanel > :is(Control)">
                <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,6,4" />
              </Style>
            </WrapPanel.Styles>
            <Button Classes="ui-btn-accent" Command="{Binding ScanModsFolderCommand}" Content="Сканировать папку mods/" />
            <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding ToggleImportCommand}" Content="Импортировать списком" />
            <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding CopyTreeListCommand}" Content="Копировать дерево + ссылки" />
            <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding CopyNamesListCommand}" Content="Копировать названия" />
            <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding ClearAssemblyCommand}" Content="Очистить" />
          </WrapPanel>
        </Grid>

        <!-- Inline Import Panel -->
        <Border IsVisible="{Binding ImportOpen}" Background="{DynamicResource SurfaceSubBrush}"
                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderLineBrush}" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="6" Padding="10">
          <StackPanel Spacing="8">
            <TextBlock Text="Вставьте список модов (по строкам, через запятую или .jar имена)"
                       FontSize="12" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
            <TextBox Classes="ui-input" AcceptsReturn="True" Height="100"
                     FontFamily="Consolas, monospace"
                     Text="{Binding ImportText, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                     Watermark="Emberbium
Nvidium
FerriteCore
ModernFix" />
            <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
              <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="12" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}">
                <Run Text="Распознано: " />
                <Run Text="{Binding ImportMatchedCount}" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#A7F3D0" />
                <Run Text=" · не найдено: " />
                <Run Text="{Binding ImportUnmatchedCount}" Foreground="#FDE68A" />
              </TextBlock>
              <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="8">
                <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding ApplyImportMergeCommand}" Content="Добавить к текущей" />
                <Button Classes="ui-btn-accent" Command="{Binding ApplyImportReplaceCommand}" Content="Заменить сборку" />
              </StackPanel>
            </Grid>
          </StackPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- Tier Counters + View Mode + Quick Search Add -->
        <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto,280">
          <WrapPanel Grid.Column="0" Orientation="Horizontal">
            <WrapPanel.Styles>
              <Style Selector="WrapPanel > :is(Control)">
                <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,6,4" />
              </Style>
            </WrapPanel.Styles>
            <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding SetTierFilterCommand}" CommandParameter="all">
              <TextBlock><Run Text="Все (" /><Run Text="{Binding TotalCount}" /><Run Text=")" /></TextBlock>
            </Button>
            <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding SetTierFilterCommand}" CommandParameter="green">
              <TextBlock Foreground="#10B981"><Run Text="Зелёные (" /><Run Text="{Binding GreenCount}" /><Run Text=")" /></TextBlock>
            </Button>
            <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding SetTierFilterCommand}" CommandParameter="lime">
              <TextBlock Foreground="#84CC16"><Run Text="Светло-зелёные (" /><Run Text="{Binding LimeCount}" /><Run Text=")" /></TextBlock>
            </Button>
            <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding SetTierFilterCommand}" CommandParameter="yellow">
              <TextBlock Foreground="#FBBF24"><Run Text="Жёлтые (" /><Run Text="{Binding YellowCount}" /><Run Text=")" /></TextBlock>
            </Button>
            <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding SetTierFilterCommand}" CommandParameter="orange">
              <TextBlock Foreground="#F97316"><Run Text="Оранжевые (" /><Run Text="{Binding OrangeCount}" /><Run Text=")" /></TextBlock>
            </Button>
            <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding SetTierFilterCommand}" CommandParameter="red">
              <TextBlock Foreground="#FB7185"><Run Text="Красные (" /><Run Text="{Binding RedCount}" /><Run Text=")" /></TextBlock>
            </Button>
          </WrapPanel>

          <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="4" Margin="8,0">
            <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding SetViewModeCommand}" CommandParameter="tree" Content="Мод → Аддоны" />
            <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding SetViewModeCommand}" CommandParameter="status" Content="По статусу" />
          </StackPanel>

          <TextBox Grid.Column="2" Classes="ui-input"
                   Text="{Binding AddSearchQuery, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                   Watermark="Добавить мод по названию / задаче..." />
        </Grid>

        <!-- Quick Add Search Suggestions -->
        <Border IsVisible="{Binding SearchSuggestions.Count}"
                Background="{DynamicResource SurfaceSolidBrush}"
                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderLineBrush}" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="6" Padding="6">
          <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding SearchSuggestions}">
            <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
              <DataTemplate>
                <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto" Margin="4,2">
                  <StackPanel Grid.Column="0">
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontSize="12" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Description}" FontSize="11" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                  </StackPanel>
                  <Button Grid.Column="1" Classes="ui-btn-accent" Padding="8,4"
                          Command="{Binding $parent[UserControl].DataContext.AddQuickModCommand}"
                          CommandParameter="{Binding}" Content="+ Добавить" />
                </Grid>
              </DataTemplate>
            </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
          </ItemsControl>
        </Border>

        <!-- Feedback Banner -->
        <Border IsVisible="{Binding FeedbackBanner, Converter={x:Static StringConverters.IsNotNullOrEmpty}}"
                Background="#262563EB" BorderBrush="#6660A5FA" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="6" Padding="10,6">
          <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
            <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" Text="{Binding FeedbackBanner}" FontSize="12" Foreground="#BFDBFE" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
            <Button Grid.Column="1" Classes="ui-btn" Padding="6,2" Command="{Binding DismissFeedbackCommand}" Content="✕" />
          </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- Presets Quick Strip -->
        <WrapPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
          <WrapPanel.Styles>
            <Style Selector="WrapPanel > :is(Control)">
              <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,6,4" />
            </Style>
          </WrapPanel.Styles>
          <TextBlock Text="Сборки:" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="11.5" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" />
          <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Presets}">
            <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
              <ItemsPanelTemplate>
                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6" />
              </ItemsPanelTemplate>
            </ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
            <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
              <DataTemplate>
                <Button Classes="ui-btn"
                        Command="{Binding $parent[UserControl].DataContext.LoadPresetCommand}"
                        CommandParameter="{Binding}"
                        Content="{Binding Name}" />
              </DataTemplate>
            </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
          </ItemsControl>
        </WrapPanel>
      </StackPanel>
    </Border>

    <!-- Diagnostics Panel -->
    <Border Classes="ui-block" IsVisible="{Binding HasAnyIssues}" Padding="0">
      <StackPanel>
        <Border Background="{DynamicResource SurfaceSubBrush}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderLineBrush}"
                BorderThickness="0,0,0,1" Padding="14,10">
          <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
            <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" Text="Возможные проблемы и лучшие решения"
                       FontSize="13.5" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
            <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="12">
              <TextBlock IsVisible="{Binding CriticalIssuesCount}" FontSize="12" FontFamily="Consolas, monospace" Foreground="#FB7185">
                <Run Text="Критично: " /><Run Text="{Binding CriticalIssuesCount}" />
              </TextBlock>
              <TextBlock IsVisible="{Binding OrangeIssuesCount}" FontSize="12" FontFamily="Consolas, monospace" Foreground="#F97316">
                <Run Text="Риск режима: " /><Run Text="{Binding OrangeIssuesCount}" />
              </TextBlock>
              <TextBlock IsVisible="{Binding YellowIssuesCount}" FontSize="12" FontFamily="Consolas, monospace" Foreground="#FBBF24">
                <Run Text="Замечания: " /><Run Text="{Binding YellowIssuesCount}" />
              </TextBlock>
            </StackPanel>
          </Grid>
        </Border>

        <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Diagnostics}">
          <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
            <DataTemplate x:DataType="vm:DiagnosticIssueViewModel">
              <Border BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderSoftBrush}" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1" Padding="14,10">
                <StackPanel Spacing="6">
                  <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
                    <StackPanel Grid.Column="0" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="8">
                      <TextBlock Text="{Binding SeverityLabel}" FontSize="12" FontWeight="Bold"
                                 Foreground="{Binding SeverityColorHex, Converter={x:Static conv:HexToBrushConverter.Instance}}" />
                      <TextBlock Text="·" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" />
                      <TextBlock Text="{Binding Title}" FontSize="13.5" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
                    </StackPanel>

                    <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
                      <ItemsControl IsVisible="{Binding IsChoiceConflict}" ItemsSource="{Binding Choices}">
                        <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                          <ItemsPanelTemplate>
                            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6" />
                          </ItemsPanelTemplate>
                        </ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                        <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                          <DataTemplate>
                            <Button Classes="ui-btn"
                                    Command="{Binding $parent[ItemsControl].DataContext.ApplyChoiceCommand}"
                                    CommandParameter="{Binding Id}"
                                    Content="{Binding Label}" />
                          </DataTemplate>
                        </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                      </ItemsControl>

                      <Button Classes="ui-btn-accent" IsVisible="{Binding HasAddFix}"
                              Command="{Binding ApplyAddFixCommand}" Content="+ Добавить зависимости" />
                      <Button Classes="ui-btn" IsVisible="{Binding HasRemoveFix}"
                              Command="{Binding ApplyRemoveFixCommand}" Content="Убрать" />
                    </StackPanel>
                  </Grid>

                  <TextBlock Text="{Binding BetweenText}" FontSize="11.5" FontFamily="Consolas, monospace"
                             Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentTextBrush}" />
                  <TextBlock Text="{Binding Problem}" FontSize="12" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
                  <TextBlock FontSize="12" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                    <Run Text="Решение: " FontWeight="SemiBold" />
                    <Run Text="{Binding BestSolution}" />
                  </TextBlock>
                </StackPanel>
              </Border>
            </DataTemplate>
          </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
        </ItemsControl>
      </StackPanel>
    </Border>

    <!-- Missing Core Slots -->
    <Border Classes="ui-block" IsVisible="{Binding HasMissingCoreSlots}" Padding="14">
      <StackPanel Spacing="8">
        <TextBlock Text="Не заполнены базовые слоты оптимизации:" FontSize="13" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="#FDE68A" />
        <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding MissingCoreSlots}">
          <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
            <DataTemplate>
              <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto" Margin="0,2">
                <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="12" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}">
                  <Run Text="{Binding GroupTitle}" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
                  <Run Text=" → рекомендуется " />
                  <Run Text="{Binding LeaderName}" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="#A7F3D0" />
                </TextBlock>
                <Button Grid.Column="1" Classes="ui-btn"
                        Command="{Binding $parent[UserControl].DataContext.AddMissingSlotLeaderCommand}"
                        CommandParameter="{Binding}" Content="+ Добавить лидера" />
              </Grid>
            </DataTemplate>
          </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
        </ItemsControl>
      </StackPanel>
    </Border>

    <!-- Mod List Rows -->
    <Border Classes="ui-block" Padding="0">
      <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Rows}">
        <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
          <DataTemplate x:DataType="vm:CheckerRowViewModel">
            <Border BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderSoftBrush}" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1" Padding="14,8">
              <Grid ColumnDefinitions="4,Auto,*,Auto">
                <Border Grid.Column="0" CornerRadius="2"
                        Background="{Binding TierColorHex, Converter={x:Static conv:HexToBrushConverter.Instance}}" />

                <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="8,0">
                  <TextBlock IsVisible="{Binding IsChild}" Text="↳" FontFamily="Consolas, monospace"
                             FontSize="12" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentTextBrush}" Width="24" TextAlignment="Right" />
                  <TextBlock IsVisible="{Binding RootIndex, Converter={x:Static ObjectConverters.IsNotNull}}"
                             Text="{Binding RootIndex, StringFormat={}{0}.}"
                             FontFamily="Consolas, monospace" FontSize="11.5"
                             Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" Width="24" TextAlignment="Right" />
                </StackPanel>

                <StackPanel Grid.Column="2" Spacing="2">
                  <WrapPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                    <Button Command="{Binding OpenDetailsCommand}" Background="Transparent" BorderThickness="0" Padding="0" Cursor="Hand">
                      <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontSize="13.5" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
                    </Button>
                    <TextBlock IsVisible="{Binding RelationLabel, Converter={x:Static StringConverters.IsNotNullOrEmpty}}"
                               Text="{Binding RelationLabel}" Margin="8,2,0,0" FontSize="11"
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentTextBrush}" />
                    <TextBlock IsVisible="{Binding ShowRowMeta}" Text="{Binding Platform}" Margin="8,2,0,0" FontSize="11"
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" />
                    <TextBlock IsVisible="{Binding UpdatedLabel, Converter={x:Static StringConverters.IsNotNullOrEmpty}}"
                               Text="{Binding UpdatedLabel}" Margin="6,2,0,0" FontSize="11"
                               FontFamily="Consolas, monospace" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" />
                  </WrapPanel>

                  <TextBlock IsVisible="{Binding HasReasonLine}" Text="{Binding DisplayLine}"
                             FontSize="12" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"
                             Foreground="{Binding TierColorHex, Converter={x:Static conv:HexToBrushConverter.Instance}}" />
                </StackPanel>

                <StackPanel Grid.Column="3" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                  <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding OpenDetailsCommand}" Content="Инфо" />
                  <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding OpenCurseForgeCommand}" Content="CF" />
                  <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding RemoveCommand}" Content="Убрать" />
                </StackPanel>
              </Grid>
            </Border>
          </DataTemplate>
        </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
      </ItemsControl>
    </Border>
  </StackPanel>
</UserControl>

<Window xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:vm="using:ModpackWorkbench.ViewModels"
        xmlns:views="using:ModpackWorkbench.Views"
        xmlns:controls="using:ModpackWorkbench.Controls"
        x:Class="ModpackWorkbench.Views.MainWindow"
        Title="Верстак сборок"
        Width="1360" Height="860"
        MinWidth="960" MinHeight="640"
        Background="{DynamicResource SurfacePageBrush}"
        Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}">

  <Grid>
    <!-- Fractal + Corner Radial Glow Backdrop -->
    <controls:FractalBackdropControl ThemeConfig="{Binding ThemeConfig}" />

    <DockPanel LastChildFill="True">
      <!-- Top Header + Metadata Strip -->
      <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Top">
        <Border Background="{DynamicResource SurfaceHeaderBrush}"
                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderLineBrush}"
                BorderThickness="0,0,0,1"
                Padding="20,0">
          <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*,Auto" Height="52">
            <!-- Brand -->
            <Button Grid.Column="0"
                    Command="{Binding SelectTabCommand}"
                    CommandParameter="assembler"
                    Background="Transparent" BorderThickness="0" Padding="0"
                    VerticalAlignment="Center" Cursor="Hand">
              <TextBlock Text="Верстак сборок"
                         FontSize="15" FontWeight="Bold"
                         Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
            </Button>

            <!-- Navigation Tabs -->
            <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Orientation="Horizontal"
                        HorizontalAlignment="Center" Spacing="20"
                        VerticalAlignment="Stretch">
              <Button Command="{Binding SelectTabCommand}" CommandParameter="catalog"
                      Background="Transparent" BorderThickness="0,0,0,2"
                      BorderBrush="{Binding IsCatalogTab, Converter={x:Static views:MainWindow.TabBorderConverter}}"
                      CornerRadius="0" Padding="4,12" Cursor="Hand">
                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
                  <TextBlock Text="Каталог" FontSize="13" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                             Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
                  <TextBlock Text="{Binding CatalogCount}" FontSize="11"
                             FontFamily="Consolas, monospace"
                             Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentTextBrush}"
                             VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                </StackPanel>
              </Button>

              <Button Command="{Binding SelectTabCommand}" CommandParameter="assembler"
                      Background="Transparent" BorderThickness="0,0,0,2"
                      BorderBrush="{Binding IsAssemblerTab, Converter={x:Static views:MainWindow.TabBorderConverter}}"
                      CornerRadius="0" Padding="4,12" Cursor="Hand">
                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
                  <TextBlock Text="Клипание" FontSize="13" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                             Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
                  <TextBlock Text="{Binding AssemblyCount}" FontSize="11"
                             FontFamily="Consolas, monospace"
                             Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentTextBrush}"
                             VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                </StackPanel>
              </Button>

              <Button Command="{Binding SelectTabCommand}" CommandParameter="presets"
                      Background="Transparent" BorderThickness="0,0,0,2"
                      BorderBrush="{Binding IsPresetsTab, Converter={x:Static views:MainWindow.TabBorderConverter}}"
                      CornerRadius="0" Padding="4,12" Cursor="Hand">
                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
                  <TextBlock Text="Сборки" FontSize="13" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                             Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
                  <TextBlock Text="{Binding PresetsCount}" FontSize="11"
                             FontFamily="Consolas, monospace"
                             Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentTextBrush}"
                             VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                </StackPanel>
              </Button>

              <Button Command="{Binding SelectTabCommand}" CommandParameter="checker"
                      Background="Transparent" BorderThickness="0,0,0,2"
                      BorderBrush="{Binding IsCheckerTab, Converter={x:Static views:MainWindow.TabBorderConverter}}"
                      CornerRadius="0" Padding="4,12" Cursor="Hand">
                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
                  <TextBlock Text="Чекер" FontSize="13" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                             Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
                  <TextBlock Text="{Binding AssemblyCount}" FontSize="11"
                             FontFamily="Consolas, monospace"
                             Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentTextBrush}"
                             VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                </StackPanel>
              </Button>
            </StackPanel>

            <!-- Actions: Theme & Quick Checker -->
            <StackPanel Grid.Column="2" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="8" VerticalAlignment="Center">
              <Button Classes="ui-btn"
                      Command="{Binding ToggleThemeDrawerCommand}"
                      Content="Тема и фон" />
              <Button Classes="ui-btn-accent"
                      Command="{Binding SelectTabCommand}"
                      CommandParameter="checker"
                      Content="Чекер" />
            </StackPanel>
          </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- Metadata Strip -->
        <Border Background="{DynamicResource SurfaceSubBrush}"
                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderSoftBrush}"
                BorderThickness="0,0,0,1"
                Padding="20,4">
          <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
            <StackPanel Grid.Column="0" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
              <TextBlock Text="База:" FontSize="11" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" />
              <TextBlock Text="{Binding DbUpdatedAt}" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                         FontFamily="Consolas, monospace" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
              <TextBlock Text="· Сохранено:" FontSize="11" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" />
              <TextBlock Text="{Binding LastSavedDate}" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                         FontFamily="Consolas, monospace" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentTextBrush}" />
            </StackPanel>
            <TextBlock Grid.Column="1"
                       Text="Forge 1.20.1 · Клипание и Чекер синхронизированы"
                       FontSize="11" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" />
          </Grid>
        </Border>
      </StackPanel>

      <!-- Main Tab Content + Optional Theme Drawer -->
      <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
        <ScrollViewer Grid.Column="0" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
          <Panel Margin="20,16" MaxWidth="1280" HorizontalAlignment="Stretch">
            <views:CatalogView DataContext="{Binding Catalog}" IsVisible="{Binding $parent[Window].DataContext.IsCatalogTab}" />
            <views:AssemblyBuilderView DataContext="{Binding AssemblyBuilder}" IsVisible="{Binding $parent[Window].DataContext.IsAssemblerTab}" />
            <views:PresetsView DataContext="{Binding Presets}" IsVisible="{Binding $parent[Window].DataContext.IsPresetsTab}" />
            <views:CheckerView DataContext="{Binding Checker}" IsVisible="{Binding $parent[Window].DataContext.IsCheckerTab}" />
          </Panel>
        </ScrollViewer>

        <!-- Theme Configurator Side Panel -->
        <Border Grid.Column="1" Width="340"
                IsVisible="{Binding IsThemeDrawerOpen}"
                Background="{DynamicResource SurfaceSolidBrush}"
                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderLineBrush}"
                BorderThickness="1,0,0,0">
          <views:ThemeConfiguratorView DataContext="{Binding ThemeConfigurator}" />
        </Border>
      </Grid>
    </DockPanel>
  </Grid>
</Window>

<Window xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:vm="using:ModpackWorkbench.ViewModels"
        x:Class="ModpackWorkbench.Views.ModDetailWindow"
        Title="Информация о моде"
        Width="720" Height="620"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterOwner"
        Background="{DynamicResource SurfaceSolidBrush}"
        Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}">

  <DockPanel Margin="20" LastChildFill="True">
    <!-- Top Header -->
    <Grid DockPanel.Dock="Top" ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto" Margin="0,0,0,12">
      <StackPanel Grid.Column="0" Spacing="4">
        <TextBlock Text="{Binding Mod.Name}" FontSize="20" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
        <WrapPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
          <WrapPanel.Styles>
            <Style Selector="WrapPanel > :is(Control)">
              <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,8,4" />
            </Style>
          </WrapPanel.Styles>
          <Border Padding="8,2" CornerRadius="4" Background="#222563EB" BorderBrush="#6660A5FA" BorderThickness="1">
            <TextBlock Text="{Binding HealthLabel}" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentTextBrush}" />
          </Border>
          <TextBlock Text="{Binding Mod.StatusLabel}" FontSize="12" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
          <TextBlock Text="{Binding Mod.Platform}" FontSize="12" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
          <TextBlock FontSize="11.5" FontFamily="Consolas, monospace" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" VerticalAlignment="Center">
            <Run Text="Обн.: " /><Run Text="{Binding UpdatedLabel}" />
          </TextBlock>
        </WrapPanel>
      </StackPanel>

      <Button Grid.Column="1" Classes="ui-btn" VerticalAlignment="Top" Command="{Binding CloseCommand}" Content="Закрыть" />
    </Grid>

    <!-- Bottom Action Bar -->
    <Grid DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto" Margin="0,12,0,0">
      <Button Grid.Column="0" Classes="ui-btn" HorizontalAlignment="Left"
              Command="{Binding OpenCurseForgeCommand}" Content="Открыть на CurseForge ↗" />
      <Button Grid.Column="1" Classes="ui-btn-accent"
              Command="{Binding ToggleInAssemblyCommand}" Content="{Binding ToggleButtonText}" />
    </Grid>

    <!-- Body -->
    <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
      <StackPanel Spacing="12">
        <Border Classes="ui-block" Padding="12">
          <StackPanel Spacing="6">
            <TextBlock Text="Описание" FontSize="12" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" />
            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Mod.Description}" FontSize="13" TextWrapping="Wrap" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
            <TextBlock IsVisible="{Binding HasTags}" Text="{Binding TagsText}" FontSize="11"
                       FontFamily="Consolas, monospace" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" />
          </StackPanel>
        </Border>

        <Border Classes="ui-block" IsVisible="{Binding HasWarning}" Padding="12" BorderBrush="#66F97316">
          <StackPanel Spacing="4">
            <TextBlock Text="Предупреждение / Риски" FontSize="12" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#FED7AA" />
            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Mod.Warning}" FontSize="12.5" TextWrapping="Wrap" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
          </StackPanel>
        </Border>

        <Border Classes="ui-block" IsVisible="{Binding HasBestAlternative}" Padding="12">
          <StackPanel Spacing="4">
            <TextBlock Text="Рекомендация / Лучшая альтернатива" FontSize="12" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#A7F3D0" />
            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Mod.BestAlternative}" FontSize="12.5" TextWrapping="Wrap" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
          </StackPanel>
        </Border>

        <Border Classes="ui-block" IsVisible="{Binding HasDualPair}" Padding="12">
          <StackPanel Spacing="8">
            <TextBlock Text="{Binding DualPair.Title}" FontSize="13" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentTextBrush}" />
            <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,10,*">
              <Border Grid.Column="0" Background="{DynamicResource SurfaceSubBrush}" CornerRadius="6" Padding="10">
                <StackPanel Spacing="4">
                  <TextBlock Text="{Binding DualPair.ForgeLabel}" FontSize="12" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#A7F3D0" />
                  <TextBlock Text="{Binding DualPair.ForgeSummary}" FontSize="11.5" TextWrapping="Wrap" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" />
                  <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding ChooseDualVariantCommand}"
                          CommandParameter="{Binding DualForgeMod}" Content="Выбрать Forge-порт" />
                </StackPanel>
              </Border>
              <Border Grid.Column="2" Background="{DynamicResource SurfaceSubBrush}" CornerRadius="6" Padding="10">
                <StackPanel Spacing="4">
                  <TextBlock Text="{Binding DualPair.FabricLabel}" FontSize="12" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#BFDBFE" />
                  <TextBlock Text="{Binding DualPair.FabricSummary}" FontSize="11.5" TextWrapping="Wrap" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" />
                  <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding ChooseDualVariantCommand}"
                          CommandParameter="{Binding DualFabricMod}" Content="Выбрать Fabric-порт" />
                </StackPanel>
              </Border>
            </Grid>
          </StackPanel>
        </Border>

        <Border Classes="ui-block" IsVisible="{Binding HasDependencies}" Padding="12">
          <StackPanel Spacing="4">
            <TextBlock Text="Обязательные зависимости" FontSize="12" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" />
            <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Dependencies}">
              <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                <DataTemplate>
                  <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontSize="12.5" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
                </DataTemplate>
              </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
            </ItemsControl>
          </StackPanel>
        </Border>
      </StackPanel>
    </ScrollViewer>
  </DockPanel>
</Window>

<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:vm="using:ModpackWorkbench.ViewModels"
             x:Class="ModpackWorkbench.Views.PresetsView">

  <StackPanel Spacing="16">
    <!-- Presets -->
    <TextBlock Text="Проверенные готовые сборки" FontSize="16" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
    <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Presets}">
      <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
        <DataTemplate x:DataType="vm:PresetCardViewModel">
          <Border Classes="ui-block" Padding="16" Margin="0,0,0,10">
            <StackPanel Spacing="10">
              <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
                <StackPanel Grid.Column="0" Spacing="4">
                  <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontSize="15" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
                  <Border HorizontalAlignment="Left" Padding="8,2" CornerRadius="4"
                          Background="#222563EB" BorderBrush="#6660A5FA" BorderThickness="1">
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Badge}" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentTextBrush}" />
                  </Border>
                </StackPanel>
                <Button Grid.Column="1" Classes="ui-btn" VerticalAlignment="Top"
                        Command="{Binding ToggleExpandedCommand}" Content="{Binding ExpandLabel}" />
              </Grid>

              <TextBlock Text="{Binding Description}" FontSize="12.5" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
              <TextBlock FontSize="11.5" Foreground="#FDE68A" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                <Run Text="Риск краша / условия: " FontWeight="SemiBold" />
                <Run Text="{Binding CrashRisk}" />
              </TextBlock>

              <!-- Expanded Mod List -->
              <Border IsVisible="{Binding IsExpanded}" Background="{DynamicResource SurfaceSubBrush}"
                      CornerRadius="6" Padding="10">
                <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding ResolvedMods}">
                  <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                    <DataTemplate>
                      <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto" Margin="0,2">
                        <Button Grid.Column="0" Background="Transparent" BorderThickness="0" Padding="0"
                                HorizontalAlignment="Left" Cursor="Hand"
                                Command="{Binding $parent[ItemsControl].DataContext.OpenModCommand}"
                                CommandParameter="{Binding}">
                          <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontSize="12" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                     Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" />
                        </Button>
                        <TextBlock Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding Category}" FontSize="11"
                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink3Brush}" />
                      </Grid>
                    </DataTemplate>
                  </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                </ItemsControl>
              </Border>

              <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="8">
                <Button Classes="ui-btn-accent" Command="{Binding LoadToBuilderCommand}" Content="Загрузить в Клипание" />
                <Button Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding LoadToCheckerCommand}" Content="Открыть в Чекере" />
              </StackPanel>
            </StackPanel>
          </Border>
        </DataTemplate>
      </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
    </ItemsControl>

    <!-- Golden Standard -->
    <TextBlock Text="Золотой стандарт оптимизации Forge 1.20.1" FontSize="15" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" Margin="0,6,0,0" />
    <Border Classes="ui-block" Padding="12">
      <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding GoldenStandard}">
        <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
          <DataTemplate x:DataType="vm:GoldenStandardItemViewModel">
            <Border BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderSoftBrush}" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1" Padding="6,6">
              <Grid ColumnDefinitions="240,*,Auto">
                <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" Text="{Binding Name}" FontSize="12.5" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                           Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                <TextBlock Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding Role}" FontSize="12"
                           Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" TextWrapping="Wrap" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                <Button Grid.Column="2" Classes="ui-btn" IsVisible="{Binding HasResolvedMod}"
                        Command="{Binding OpenDetailCommand}" Content="Инфо" />
              </Grid>
            </Border>
          </DataTemplate>
        </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
      </ItemsControl>
    </Border>
  </StackPanel>
</UserControl>

<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:vm="using:ModpackWorkbench.ViewModels"
             x:Class="ModpackWorkbench.Views.ThemeConfiguratorView">

  <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
    <StackPanel Spacing="12" Margin="16">
      <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
        <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" Text="Настройки темы и фона" FontSize="14" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink1Brush}" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
        <Button Grid.Column="1" Classes="ui-btn" Command="{Binding ResetThemeCommand}" Content="Сброс" />
      </Grid>

      <!-- Mode -->
      <Border Classes="ui-block" Padding="10">
        <StackPanel Spacing="6">
          <ToggleSwitch IsChecked="{Binding IsDarkMode}" OnContent="Тёмная тема" OffContent="Светлая тема" />
          <CheckBox IsChecked="{Binding Animate}" Content="Анимация фона" FontSize="12" />
          <CheckBox IsChecked="{Binding MultiFractal}" Content="Мультифрактальные слои" FontSize="12" />
        </StackPanel>
      </Border>

      <!-- Presets -->
      <StackPanel Spacing="6">
        <TextBlock Text="Пресеты оформления" FontSize="12" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" />
        <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Presets}">
          <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
            <DataTemplate>
              <Button Classes="ui-btn" HorizontalAlignment="Stretch" Margin="0,0,0,4"
                      Command="{Binding $parent[UserControl].DataContext.ApplyPresetCommand}"
                      CommandParameter="{Binding Config}"
                      Content="{Binding Label}" />
            </DataTemplate>
          </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
        </ItemsControl>
      </StackPanel>

      <!-- Sliders -->
      <Border Classes="ui-block" Padding="10">
        <StackPanel Spacing="8">
          <TextBlock Text="Угол свечения" FontSize="11.5" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" />
          <Slider Minimum="0" Maximum="360" Value="{Binding Angle}" />

          <TextBlock Text="Насыщенность фона" FontSize="11.5" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" />
          <Slider Minimum="0" Maximum="100" Value="{Binding Saturation}" />

          <TextBlock Text="Прозрачность панелей" FontSize="11.5" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" />
          <Slider Minimum="0" Maximum="100" Value="{Binding PanelTransparency}" />

          <TextBlock Text="Яркость фракталов" FontSize="11.5" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" />
          <Slider Minimum="0" Maximum="100" Value="{Binding FractalOpacity}" />

          <TextBlock Text="Масштаб фракталов" FontSize="11.5" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" />
          <Slider Minimum="10" Maximum="100" Value="{Binding FractalScale}" />

          <TextBlock Text="Неопределённость фракталов" FontSize="11.5" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" />
          <Slider Minimum="0" Maximum="100" Value="{Binding FractalUncertainty}" />
        </StackPanel>
      </Border>

      <!-- Fractal & Layout Selectors -->
      <Border Classes="ui-block" Padding="10">
        <StackPanel Spacing="8">
          <TextBlock Text="Основной фрактал" FontSize="11.5" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" />
          <ComboBox ItemsSource="{Binding FractalOptions}"
                    SelectedValue="{Binding SelectedFractal}"
                    SelectedValueBinding="{Binding Key}"
                    DisplayMemberBinding="{Binding Label}" HorizontalAlignment="Stretch" />

          <TextBlock Text="Вторичный фрактал" FontSize="11.5" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" />
          <ComboBox ItemsSource="{Binding FractalOptions}"
                    SelectedValue="{Binding SelectedFractalSecondary}"
                    SelectedValueBinding="{Binding Key}"
                    DisplayMemberBinding="{Binding Label}" HorizontalAlignment="Stretch" />

          <TextBlock Text="Скругление блоков" FontSize="11.5" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" />
          <ComboBox ItemsSource="{Binding BlockRadiusOptions}"
                    SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedBlockRadius}" HorizontalAlignment="Stretch" />

          <TextBlock Text="Стиль панелей" FontSize="11.5" Foreground="{DynamicResource Ink2Brush}" />
          <ComboBox ItemsSource="{Binding BlockStyleOptions}"
                    SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedBlockStyle}" HorizontalAlignment="Stretch" />
        </StackPanel>
      </Border>

      <!-- Display Flags -->
      <Border Classes="ui-block" Padding="10">
        <StackPanel Spacing="4">
          <CheckBox IsChecked="{Binding ShowDescriptions}" Content="Показывать описания в строках" FontSize="12" />
          <CheckBox IsChecked="{Binding ShowRowMeta}" Content="Метаданные (Sinytra, даты)" FontSize="12" />
          <CheckBox IsChecked="{Binding ShowRowNumbers}" Content="Нумерация в чекере" FontSize="12" />
        </StackPanel>
      </Border>
    </StackPanel>
  </ScrollViewer>
</UserControl>
